remarks: WOW First time on the market in over 40 years! Situated on a corner lot along a quiet, tree-lined street in Lakewood’s established Lakewood Park neighborhood, 5439 Hersholt Avenue offers classic charm, a private swimming pool and exciting possibilities. Original hardwood floors bring warmth and character, while upgraded dual-pane windows and fully paid-off solar panels add modern appeal. The primary bedroom features its own private bathroom. A spacious family room between the house and garage provides flexible space for entertaining, relaxing or potential rental income.
